title: The session-start peers line sits above the sprint lines, so the hook's 1000-character cap cuts every sprint line when the checkout lags
goal: The session-start hook keeps at least the first sprint line under its 1000-character cap when the checkout-lag line and the peers line are both present, the peers line being cut before any sprint line, and a check plants a lag line, a peers line and an active sprint and finds a sprint line in the hook's systemMessage

run: import json,subprocess,sys; m=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","horizon","--hook"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)["systemMessage"]; sys.exit(0 if "sprint SP-" in m else 1)
